description: This file contains shell scripts for platform-specific upgrade operations in an OpenWrt-based system, including image validation, partition management, EFI system partition handling, and upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of a provided image for compatibility before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to a specific partition during upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI system partition with necessary EFI boot files from the provided image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function orchestrating partition updates, EFI handling, and filesystem modifications.
